faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Everything you need to know about working with Up-Brands — our services, process, pricing, and how to get started.
faq.cta_desc: Tell us about your brand and we will get back to you with a free initial diagnosis and tailored suggestions.

items.question: What services does Up-Brands provide?
items.answer: We provide three core services — brand strategy, creative visual design, and digital marketing — delivered bilingually in English and Chinese. This covers research and insights, strategic positioning, naming, visual identity, packaging, UI/UX, and campaign-ready content.

items.question: Do you handle both branding and marketing?
items.answer: Yes. We connect strategy, visual identity, packaging, and digital marketing so that your brand stays coherent from the first touchpoint to final conversion.

items.question: Can you take on a single deliverable, such as a logo or packaging?
items.answer: Yes. While we recommend a complete brand system, we also accept focused projects such as packaging design, a logo refresh, or a single campaign.

items.question: What does a typical project process look like?
items.answer: Requirement discussion, brand diagnosis, strategy proposal, creative execution, delivery and optimization, then ongoing support. Every stage is transparent and open to adjustment.

items.question: How long does a brand project take?
items.answer: Timelines depend on scope. A focused deliverable can be completed in a few weeks, while a full brand system usually spans six to twelve weeks from diagnosis to final delivery.

items.question: How do you work with clients remotely?
items.answer: We are based in Zhuhai and collaborate with clients across the Greater Bay Area and internationally through online meetings, shared documents, and bilingual deliverables.

items.question: How is pricing calculated?
items.answer: Pricing is tailored to project scope and complexity, typically ranging from tens of thousands to several hundred thousand RMB. We provide a transparent quote based on your specific needs.

items.question: Do you offer a free initial consultation?
items.answer: Yes. We offer a free preliminary brand diagnosis and a customized proposal before any commitment.

items.question: What are your payment terms?
items.answer: Projects are typically staged, starting with a deposit and followed by milestone-based payments, with the final balance due on delivery.

items.question: Where are you based, and which regions do you serve?
items.answer: We are rooted in Zhuhai and serve the Greater Bay Area — Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Zhuhai, Zhongshan, Foshan, Hong Kong, and Macau — as well as international clients remotely.

items.question: How do I start a project with Up-Brands?
items.answer: Reach out by email, phone, WhatsApp, or WeChat. We will schedule a discovery conversation and provide a free initial diagnosis.

items.question: Do you provide support after delivery?
items.answer: Yes. We offer post-delivery support and can continue with brand management, content, and marketing as your business grows.

signage-system.title: Signage System
signage-system.summary: End-to-end signage and wayfinding systems — from strategy and design to production-ready specifications for retail, hospitality, and commercial spaces.
signage-system.intro: A signage system turns a brand into a physical experience. We design signage and wayfinding that guide people clearly, reinforce your identity at every touchpoint, and are ready for real fabrication.

sections.title: Wayfinding Strategy
sections.desc: We map user journeys, decision points, and information hierarchy so visitors always know where they are and where to go next.

sections.title: Signage Design & Identity
sections.desc: Facade, interior, and directional signage designed to match your visual identity — materials, typography, colour, and lighting considered together.

sections.title: Production & Rollout
sections.desc: Fabrication-ready drawings, material specifications, and vendor coordination so the system is built consistently across every location.

deliverables: Facade, interior, and directional signage design

branding-upgrade.title: Branding Upgrade
branding-upgrade.summary: A structured brand refresh for businesses whose identity no longer matches their ambition — repositioning, visual renewal, and a clearer system across every touchpoint.
branding-upgrade.intro: Brands drift. Markets move, offers evolve, and the identity that worked at launch can start to feel dated or inconsistent. A branding upgrade realigns strategy and visual expression so your brand looks as strong as the business behind it.

sections.title: Brand Audit & Positioning
sections.desc: We review every current touchpoint, interview stakeholders, and redefine the positioning that the refreshed identity needs to express.

sections.title: Visual Identity Renewal
sections.desc: Logo refinement or redesign, typography, colour, imagery, and layout systems that feel current without losing the equity you have already built.

sections.title: System & Rollout
sections.desc: Updated brand guidelines, templates, and application assets so the new identity is used consistently across print, packaging, and digital.

deliverables: Application templates for print and digital

ip-design.title: IP Design
ip-design.summary: Character and IP development that gives your brand a memorable personality — mascot design, IP systems, and artwork ready for packaging, campaigns, and merchandise.
ip-design.intro: A strong IP gives your brand a face people remember and want to engage with. We design original characters and IP systems that carry your brand story across packaging, social content, events, and licensed merchandise.

sections.title: IP Strategy & Story
sections.desc: We define the character's role, personality, and narrative so the IP is not just decorative but does real work for the brand.

sections.title: Character & Visual Development
sections.desc: Original character design, expression sets, poses, and a visual language that stays recognisable across many applications.

sections.title: Application & Merchandise
sections.desc: Packaging, stickers, social templates, and merchandise-ready artwork so the IP can be deployed consistently and commercially.

deliverables: Original character design and expression sets
